mapper.select: SELECT raw.raw_attendance_fact_id, raw.source_version, raw.canonical_payload_digest, raw.received_at, oa.knowledge_rank, oa.oa_attendance_document_id, oa.document_type, oa.source_status, COALESCE(raw.interval_start, raw.source_instant) AS start_instant, COALESCE(raw.interval_end, raw.source_instant) AS end_instant, matched.employee_id, matched.employment_period_id, matched.resolver_snapshot_digest, context.overtime_type, oa.leave_type, oa.leave_serial, oa.original_leave_serial FROM raw_attendance_fact raw LEFT JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id AND normalized.normalization_revision = ( SELECT MAX(revision.normalization_revision) FROM normalized_attendance_record revision WHERE revision.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id) LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document oa ON oa.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context context ON context.oa_attendance_document_id = oa.oa_attendance_document_id LEFT JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id WHERE raw.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND raw.source_business_key = #{sourceBusinessKey} AND raw.fact_kind = 'OA_DOCUMENT' AND oa.oa_attendance_document_id IS NOT NULL AND matched.match_status = 'MATCHED' ORDER BY raw.received_at DESC, oa.knowledge_rank DESC, oa.created_at DESC, oa.oa_attendance_document_id DESC, raw.received_at DESC, raw.raw_attendance_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT source_business_key FROM ( SELECT source_business_key FROM raw_attendance_fact WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND fact_kind = 'OA_DOCUMENT' AND ((interval_start < #{toExclusive} AND interval_end > #{fromInclusive}) OR (source_instant >= #{fromInclusive} AND source_instant < #{toExclusive})) UNION
SELECT amendment_raw.source_business_key FROM raw_attendance_fact original_raw JOIN normalized_attendance_record original_normalized ON original_normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id = original_raw.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN oa_attendance_document original ON original.normalized_attendance_record_id = original_normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND original.document_type = 'LEAVE' JOIN employee_match_decision original_match ON original_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = original_normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' JOIN oa_attendance_document amendment ON amendment.attendance_source_id = original.attendance_source_id AND amendment.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' JOIN normalized_attendance_record amendment_normalized ON amendment_normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN raw_attendance_fact amendment_raw ON amendment_raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = amendment_normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id AND amendment_raw.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND amendment_raw.fact_kind = 'OA_DOCUMENT' JOIN employee_match_decision amendment_match ON amendment_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment_normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND amendment_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' AND amendment_match.employee_id = original_match.employee_id WHERE original_raw.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND original_raw.fact_kind = 'OA_DOCUMENT' AND original_raw.interval_start < #{toExclusive} AND original_raw.interval_end > #{fromInclusive} AND ( (NULLIF(TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(original.leave_serial) = TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial)) OR (NULLIF(TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial), '') IS NULL AND COALESCE(amendment_raw.interval_start, amendment_raw.source_instant) >= original_raw.interval_start AND COALESCE(amendment_raw.interval_end, amendment_raw.source_instant) <= original_raw.interval_end) ) ) dependencies ORDER BY source_business_key

SELECT raw.raw_attendance_fact_id, normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id, normalized.normalization_revision, normalized.validation_status, normalized.issue_code, matched.match_status, matched.match_reason, matched.employee_id AS match_employee_id, matched.employment_period_id, event.effective_attendance_event_id, event.employee_id AS event_employee_id FROM raw_attendance_fact raw LEFT JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id AND normalized.normalization_revision = ( SELECT MAX(latest.normalization_revision) FROM normalized_attendance_record latest WHERE latest.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id ) LEFT JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id LEFT JOIN evidence_link link ON link.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id AND link.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id LEFT JOIN effective_attendance_event event ON event.effective_attendance_event_id = link.effective_attendance_event_id AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' WHERE raw.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND raw.source_business_key = #{sourceBusinessKey} AND raw.source_version = #{sourceVersion} ORDER BY CASE link.link_type WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, link.evidence_link_id LIMIT 1

SELECT raw_attendance_fact_id, attendance_source_id, company_id, fact_kind, source_business_key, source_version, stable_fingerprint, source_time_text, source_time_zone, source_instant, interval_start, interval_end, canonical_payload_digest, raw_object_ref, request_id, received_at, created_by FROM raw_attendance_fact WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND stable_fingerprint = #{stableFingerprint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raw_attendance_fact ( raw_attendance_fact_id, attendance_source_id, company_id, fact_kind, source_business_key, source_version, stable_fingerprint, source_time_text, source_time_zone, source_instant, interval_start, interval_end, verification_method, location_summary, longitude_raw, latitude_raw, source_coordinate_system, coordinate_validation_status, coordinate_conversion_status, map_longitude, map_latitude, map_coordinate_system, canonical_payload_digest, raw_object_ref, request_id, received_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{rawAttendanceFactId}, #{attendanceSourceId}, #{companyId}, #{factKind}, #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{stableFingerprint}, #{sourceTimeText}, #{sourceTimeZone}, #{sourceInstant}, #{intervalStart}, #{intervalEnd}, #{verificationMethod}, #{locationSummary}, #{longitudeRaw}, #{latitudeRaw}, COALESCE(#{sourceCoordinateSystem}, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(#{coordinateValidationStatus}, 'MISSING'), COALESCE(#{coordinateConversionStatus}, 'NOT_APPLICABLE'), #{mapLongitude}, #{mapLatitude}, #{mapCoordinateSystem}, #{canonicalPayloadDigest}, #{rawObjectRef}, #{requestId}, #{receivedAt}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO raw_attendance_fact ( raw_attendance_fact_id, attendance_source_id, company_id, fact_kind, source_business_key, source_version, stable_fingerprint, source_time_text, source_time_zone, source_instant, interval_start, interval_end, verification_method, location_summary, longitude_raw, latitude_raw, source_coordinate_system, coordinate_validation_status, coordinate_conversion_status, map_longitude, map_latitude, map_coordinate_system, canonical_payload_digest, raw_object_ref, request_id, received_at, created_by ) VALUES
( #{r.rawAttendanceFactId}, #{r.attendanceSourceId}, #{r.companyId}, #{r.factKind}, #{r.sourceBusinessKey}, #{r.sourceVersion}, #{r.stableFingerprint}, #{r.sourceTimeText}, #{r.sourceTimeZone}, #{r.sourceInstant}, #{r.intervalStart}, #{r.intervalEnd}, #{r.verificationMethod}, #{r.locationSummary}, #{r.longitudeRaw}, #{r.latitudeRaw}, COALESCE(#{r.sourceCoordinateSystem}, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(#{r.coordinateValidationStatus}, 'MISSING'), COALESCE(#{r.coordinateConversionStatus}, 'NOT_APPLICABLE'), #{r.mapLongitude}, #{r.mapLatitude}, #{r.mapCoordinateSystem}, #{r.canonicalPayloadDigest}, #{r.rawObjectRef}, #{r.requestId}, #{r.receivedAt}, #{r.createdBy} )

INSERT INTO normalized_attendance_record ( normalized_attendance_record_id, raw_attendance_fact_id, normalization_revision, schema_version, record_kind, normalized_direction, point_instant, interval_start, interval_end, validation_status, issue_code, canonical_digest, supersedes_normalized_record_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{normalizedAttendanceRecordId}, #{rawAttendanceFactId}, #{normalizationRevision}, #{schemaVersion}, #{recordKind}, #{normalizedDirection}, #{pointInstant}, #{intervalStart}, #{intervalEnd}, #{validationStatus}, #{issueCode}, #{canonicalDigest}, #{supersedesNormalizedRecordId}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO normalized_attendance_record ( normalized_attendance_record_id, raw_attendance_fact_id, normalization_revision, schema_version, record_kind, normalized_direction, point_instant, interval_start, interval_end, validation_status, issue_code, canonical_digest, supersedes_normalized_record_id, created_at ) VALUES
( #{r.normalizedAttendanceRecordId}, #{r.rawAttendanceFactId}, #{r.normalizationRevision}, #{r.schemaVersion}, #{r.recordKind}, #{r.normalizedDirection}, #{r.pointInstant}, #{r.intervalStart}, #{r.intervalEnd}, #{r.validationStatus}, #{r.issueCode}, #{r.canonicalDigest}, #{r.supersedesNormalizedRecordId}, #{r.createdAt} )

INSERT INTO employee_match_decision ( employee_match_decision_id, normalized_attendance_record_id, match_status, match_reason, employee_id, employment_period_id, device_person_binding_id, resolver_snapshot_digest, created_at ) VALUES
( #{r.employeeMatchDecisionId}, #{r.normalizedAttendanceRecordId}, #{r.matchStatus}, #{r.matchReason}, #{r.employeeId}, #{r.employmentPeriodId}, #{r.devicePersonBindingId}, #{r.resolverSnapshotDigest}, #{r.createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT event.effective_attendance_event_id, event.company_id, event.employee_id, event.event_kind, event.normalized_direction, event.point_instant, event.interval_start, event.interval_end, event.canonical_digest, event.created_at FROM effective_attendance_event event WHERE event.company_id = #{companyId} AND event.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND event.point_instant = #{pointInstant} AND event.normalized_direction = #{normalizedDirection} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY event.effective_attendance_event_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_recalculation_intent ( attendance_recalculation_intent_id, company_id, employee_id, business_date, reason_code, effective_attendance_event_id, resolver_snapshot_digest, period_version, request_id, intent_digest, created_at ) VALUES ( #{attendanceRecalculationIntentId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{businessDate}, #{reasonCode}, #{effectiveAttendanceEventId}, #{resolverSnapshotDigest}, #{periodVersion}, #{requestId}, #{intentDigest}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT event.effective_attendance_event_id, lifecycle.lifecycle_type, lifecycle.knowledge_at, link.evidence_link_id, raw.raw_attendance_fact_id, raw.attendance_source_id, raw.fact_kind, raw.source_business_key, raw.source_version, raw.canonical_payload_digest, normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id, normalized.validation_status AS normalization_status, matched.employee_match_decision_id, matched.match_status, matched.match_reason FROM effective_attendance_event event JOIN effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle ON lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id JOIN evidence_link link ON link.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = link.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = link.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.employee_match_decision_id = link.employee_match_decision_id WHERE event.company_id = #{companyId} AND event.effective_attendance_event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id, link.evidence_link_id

SELECT raw.raw_attendance_fact_id, raw.attendance_source_id, raw.company_id, raw.fact_kind, raw.source_business_key, raw.source_version, raw.stable_fingerprint, raw.source_time_text, raw.source_time_zone, raw.source_instant, raw.interval_start, raw.interval_end, raw.canonical_payload_digest, raw.raw_object_ref, raw.request_id, raw.received_at, raw.created_by FROM raw_attendance_fact raw JOIN oa_attendance_document oa ON oa.normalized_attendance_record_id IN ( SELECT nm.normalized_attendance_record_id FROM normalized_attendance_record nm WHERE nm.raw_attendance_fact_id = raw.raw_attendance_fact_id ) WHERE raw.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND raw.source_business_key = #{sourceBusinessKey} AND raw.source_version = #{sourceVersion} LIMIT 1

SELECT contract.oa_runtime_contract_revision_id FROM oa_runtime_contract_revision contract WHERE contract.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND contract.contract_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY contract.revision_number DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_attendance_document ( oa_attendance_document_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, document_type, leave_type, leave_serial, original_leave_serial, source_status, normalized_attendance_record_id, knowledge_rank, supersedes_document_id, first_submitted_at, approved_at, modified_at, revoked_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{oaAttendanceDocumentId}, #{attendanceSourceId}, #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{documentType}, #{leaveType}, #{leaveSerial}, #{originalLeaveSerial}, #{sourceStatus}, #{normalizedAttendanceRecordId}, #{knowledgeRank}, #{supersedesDocumentId}, #{firstSubmittedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{modifiedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt} )
